• Mohun Bagan Super Giant vs Odisha FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 25 || 05-Nov-2026 || English ||
Five goals and a late winner at Salt Lake! Watch the big moments as Mohun Bagan Super Giant beat Odisha FC 3-2 to go back to the top of the MG Indian Super League 2026-27 table.
All five goals came after half-time. Dejan Dražić twice put the Mariners ahead, and both times Odisha hit back, through Mahmoud Eid and then Everton. Lee Erwin had the final say with the winner three minutes from time.
